title: User Authentication
description: Users must be able to log in with valid credentials and be rejected on invalid ones

title: Employee Management (PIM)
description: Admins must be able to add, search, and delete employee records

title: Leave Management
description: Employees must be able to apply for leave; admins must be able to approve or reject

title: Recruitment Management
description: Admins must be able to create vacancies and manage the applicant pipeline

title: Dashboard Overview
description: Authenticated users must see a summary dashboard with key widgets on login
